response.sql: WITH invoice_data AS (SELECT i.InvoiceId, c.Country, AVG(il.UnitPrice) as invoice_avg_price FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(invoice_avg_price) as overall_average FROM invoice_data), invoice_deviations AS (SELECT id.InvoiceId, id.Country, id.invoice_avg_price, (id.invoice_avg_price - oa.overall_average) as deviation FROM invoice_data id CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa), country_avg_deviations AS (SELECT Country, AVG(deviation) as country_avg_deviation FROM invoice_deviations GROUP BY Country), final_calc AS (SELECT id.InvoiceId, id.Country, id.invoice_avg_price, id.deviation, (id.deviation - cad.country_avg_deviation) as deviation_minus_country_avg FROM invoice_deviations id LEFT JOIN country_avg_deviations cad ON (id.Country = cad.Country OR (id.Country IS NULL AND cad.Country IS NULL))) SELECT InvoiceId, Country, invoice_avg_price, deviation, deviation_minus_country_avg FROM final_calc ORDER BY CASE WHEN deviation_minus_country_avg IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, deviation_minus_country_avg DESC, InvoiceId LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Invoices with NULL customer countries are included and grouped together for computing country average deviations, treating NULL as a valid (though unusual) country value

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude invoices where the customer's country is NULL, treating "for each country" as implicitly excluding NULL
alternatives.sql: WITH invoice_data AS (SELECT i.InvoiceId, c.Country, AVG(il.UnitPrice) as invoice_avg_price FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId WHERE c.Country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(invoice_avg_price) as overall_average FROM invoice_data), invoice_deviations AS (SELECT id.InvoiceId, id.Country, id.invoice_avg_price, (id.invoice_avg_price - oa.overall_average) as deviation FROM invoice_data id CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa), country_avg_deviations AS (SELECT Country, AVG(deviation) as country_avg_deviation FROM invoice_deviations GROUP BY Country), final_calc AS (SELECT id.InvoiceId, id.Country, id.invoice_avg_price, id.deviation, (id.deviation - cad.country_avg_deviation) as deviation_minus_country_avg FROM invoice_deviations id LEFT JOIN country_avg_deviations cad ON id.Country = cad.Country) SELECT InvoiceId, Country, invoice_avg_price, deviation, deviation_minus_country_avg FROM final_calc ORDER BY CASE WHEN deviation_minus_country_avg IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, deviation_minus_country_avg DESC, InvoiceId LIMIT 10
